summary: A short line about a control, in a small inverted box beside it with an arrow toward it: shown once the pointer rests on the control or while it has keyboard focus, and gone when both leave. It names an icon button, says why a control is off (a button's reason), and can add the key that does the same.

anatomy.trigger: The control the tooltip speaks for. Below 768 it takes a finger's hit area, centered on it, and keeps its drawn size.
anatomy.box: The line on the foreground ground in the background's ink: one line as wide as its words up to 320, then wrapping. Beside the trigger, above it by default, 4 away, centered on it.
anatomy.arrow: A 10 square turned 45 degrees at the box's edge toward the trigger, in the box's ground.
anatomy.keys: The key that does the same, after the words: a small key cap on a wash of the background over the box's ground.

side.does: Which side of the trigger the box stands on; it moves to the other side when there is no room.

align.does: Where along that side the box lines up with the trigger.

sideOffset.does: How far the box stands from the trigger.

delay.does: ms the pointer rests on the trigger before the box shows; keyboard focus shows it at once.
delay.sokkel-ui: Base UI's 600 by default; TooltipProvider delay, 0 unless set, for the tooltips inside it

open.does: Shown whatever the pointer does, as a story or a guided tour shows it.

keys.does: A key after the words, drawn as a key cap.

box.note: At most 320 wide (layout.maxWidth); with keys its end pads 6.

arrow.note: Turned 45 degrees, half of it out past the box's edge.

gap.note: Between the trigger and the box.

keysPadEnd.note: The box's end pad when it holds keys.

openDelay.note: ms before the box shows under a resting pointer: Base UI's own, for a tooltip outside a TooltipProvider; 0 inside sokkel-ui's TooltipProvider, whose tooltips share one delay group.

open.reached: the pointer resting on the trigger for the delay, keyboard focus on the trigger, or open

keyboard.does: Shows the box while the trigger has keyboard focus.
Hides the box; focus stays on the trigger.

appText.text: What the control does or why it is off, and the keys that do the same; never the only place a thing is said.

sokkel-ui: Base UI's Tooltip: the box is a portal on z-50, shown on hover and on focus-visible, and it moves to the other side of the trigger when there is no room.
Outside a TooltipProvider a tooltip waits Base UI's 600 ms; sokkel-ui's TooltipProvider sets 0, and its tooltips share one delay group.
TooltipTrigger adds the finger hit area (FINGER_HIT) unless its render element places itself or draws its own ::after (takesFinger).
The box fades and zooms in from the trigger's side.
A Button's reason and an IconButton's name show in this tooltip.
The rail's collapsed entries and SwitchField's reason draw a box of their own on the popover ground, without an arrow (parts/rail).
sokkel-ui-egui: tooltip(response, text) shows it under a resting pointer or with keyboard focus; tooltip_shown(response, text) shows it whatever the pointer does.
Hover comes from last frame's rects; the delay counts from the first frame the pointer is over the trigger.

drift.spec: Above the trigger by default, 4 away, centered; side and align as options.
drift.today: As of 26b411f (overlay.rs unchanged since bee2a97): always under the trigger (RectAlign::BOTTOM), 4 away.

drift.spec: 600 ms under a resting pointer, 0 inside a provider; keyboard focus shows it at once.
drift.today: 0.5 s (TOOLTIP_DELAY); keyboard focus shows it at once.

As of 26b411f, the tooltip draws the box on the foreground ground in the background's ink, radius-md, padded 12 by 6, text.help, at most 320 wide, on hover and keyboard focus. Not yet: the arrow, keys, side and align, a delay group, Escape, and the finger hit area below 768.
